about: Companion refusal messages of validate_measurement_declaration and build_measurement_identity as produced on origin/main 4fc194b, before source_kind existed. The default companion bundle must keep them byte-identical (Signal Import Engine plan, U6).

no_object.message: Companion run_metadata.json declares no "measurement" object: nothing to validate. Add the object to declare the asset identity of the file (required fields: ['asset_id', 'measurement_point_id', 'acquired_at']).

not_a_dict.message: Invalid "measurement" object in companion run_metadata.json: expected a JSON object with the fields ['asset_id', 'measurement_point_id', 'acquired_at', 'rpm', 'load', 'operating_state', 'sensor_id', 'direction', 'declared_by'], got list. Fix the "measurement" object and re-load the file, or remove the object to load the file without asset identity.

unknown_fields.message: Invalid "measurement" object in companion run_metadata.json: unknown field(s) ['Asset', 'shaft_speed']: the object accepts only ['asset_id', 'measurement_point_id', 'acquired_at', 'rpm', 'load', 'operating_state', 'sensor_id', 'direction', 'declared_by']; keep free-form keys at the top level of the companion, where they pass verbatim into source_metadata. bad_ids.message: Invalid "measurement" object in companion run_metadata.json: Invalid asset_id 'NUL': is a Windows reserved device name. A ledger id must start with a letter or digit, use only letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.', end with neither a dot nor a space, have at most 100 characters, and not be a Windows reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9, with or without an extension).; Invalid measurement_point_id '../x'. Use only alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, or dot characters (no path separators). A ledger id must start with a letter or digit, use only letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.', end with neither a dot nor a space, have at most 100 characters, and not be a Windows reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9, with or without an extension).. Fix the "measurement" object and re-load the file, or remove the object to load the file without asset identity.

bad_time.message: Invalid "measurement" object in companion run_metadata.json: Invalid acquired_at 'yesterday': declare an ISO 8601 timestamp string such as '2026-08-20T13:42:00+02:00' (an offset or 'Z' declares the timezone; without one the instant is ordered as UTC and flagged timezone_declared=false).. Fix the "measurement" object and re-load the file, or remove the object to load the file without asset identity.
